'''Eddie Brown''' (also published as '''Ed Brown''')<ref name="dt-12366">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/12366 Black Death], DeckTech (Eddie "ISBop" Brown, 17 December 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/12366/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/12366/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018083219/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/12366/ Wayback Machine].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''ISBop''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|Ralltiir Operations]] list on DeckTech in December 2000. Eddie Brown also had a deck published on [[Trandosite]], [[Rod Latham]]'s UK fan site, as Ed Brown.<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls26.htm Follow and Battle], [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040306151641/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls26.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
